rubric.item: Single-turn stand-in: parenthesis is the user's scripted refusal of the preferences item the agent would offer
rubric.note: Agent treated the parenthesis as the reply to its own preferences offer: it shows no preferences prompt and acknowledges the refusal with '商家偏好先不配置'.

rubric.item: After refusal nothing written to the workspace and nothing sent to the ERP
rubric.note: Trace shows only medusa.get_started; no admin_post call, and the hard checks confirm no merchants dir or preferences.md.

rubric.item: Says it will ask when a task needs a setting, does not re-offer, still gives menu and erp_url, in Chinese
rubric.note: Says '之后哪个任务需要用到某项设置…我到时再问你', does not offer preferences again, lists a 4-item menu, includes the erp_url link, all in Chinese.

agent_unsure: Agent left research and video off the menu because it could not check endpoints, read the parenthesis as a refusal so it never showed a preferences line, opened no browser, and noted that get_started's date (2026-10-06) differs from the session date (2026-10-07).
